test_cases.description: A masked man entered a bank at night carrying a handgun. He threatened the cashier and escaped through the back door.
A thief approached an ATM at midnight carrying a handgun. He threatened a security guard, stole cash, and escaped in a car.
A thief broke into a house at midnight through a window. The victim was sleeping inside. The thief stole a laptop and jewelry and escaped.
A man killed another person inside a house at night.
